tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe established a gradient effect, but all observations still have H = 0.6 and identical initial conditions. A trajectory batch can distinguish the coupled transfer dynamics needed for a reliable forecast.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven observations share the same horizon and initial state, so they do not identify the transfer dynamics or distinguish competing saturation laws.
The bridge signatures favor this family, but its time-dependent parameters remain ambiguous without trajectory observations.
It does not address the mechanism-identification ambiguity.
